content: A GitLab France S.A.S. employee can take 5 days of family care leave if the child is under 12 months old [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Family Care Leave]
When your family needs you, GitLab provides time to care for ill family members, ensuring you can be there during challenging times.

Eligibility Requirements

All GitLab France S.A.S. team members
Medical certificate required

Key Features

3 days per year for family care
5 days if child is under 12 months old
Generally unpaid unless eligible for GitLab Sick Time policy

How to Request

- Contact Absence Management Team at leaves@gitlab.com
- Submit medical certificate with your request
- Specify dates needed

[2] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves]
GitLab France offers comprehensive parental leave benefits that meet or exceed statutory requirements. Whether you're welcoming your first child or growing your family, we provide the time and financial support you need during this important life transition.

[3] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Parental Leave]
Flexibility for ongoing childcare needs.  

Leave Entitlement

- Up to 26 weeks unpaid leave  
- For children under 12 (16 with disability)  
- Can split into blocks with manager approval  
- Requires 1 year employment

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Sign confirmation document 4 weeks before leave

Question: How many days of family care leave can a GitLab France S.A.S. employee take if the child is under 12 months old?
